Troubleshooting

If the application fails to start, first check the log file in the data directory. Most startup errors are caused by a missing configuration value or a port that is already in use.

If the log file is empty, confirm that the service account has permission to write to the folder. On some systems, this requires a manual change.

If none of these steps resolve the issue, contact the support team and include the log file with your request.
